name: Balia'mah Trophy
summary: The Balia'mah Trophy is a Skullsplitter trophy skull taken from the ruins in Stranglethorn Vale. Nezzliok asks for it alongside two other trophies at the Bubbling Cauldron in Grom'gol Base Camp.

sections.title: A Skullsplitter Trophy
sections.body: Among the ruins of Balia'mah in Stranglethorn Vale, the Skullsplitters keep trophy skulls in a pile. One skull from that pile is the Balia'mah Trophy, wanted with trophies from Ziata'jai and Zul'Mamwe.

faq.answer: The Balia'mah Trophy is a skull taken from the Skullsplitter trophy pile at Balia'mah Ruins in Stranglethorn Vale.
The dead witch doctor Nezzliok asks for the Balia'mah Trophy along with trophies from Ziata'jai and Zul'Mamwe.

faq.q: Where is the Balia'mah Trophy from?
faq.answer: The Balia'mah Trophy comes from the pile of trophy skulls at Balia'mah Ruins in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Where do the three trophies go?
faq.answer: Nezzliok asks that the Balia'mah, Ziata'jai and Zul'Mamwe trophies be placed at the Bubbling Cauldron in Grom'gol Base Camp.
